note: L1 and R1 were run once each as smoke probes while the arms were being wired; R1 is IN the set precisely because that probe found a semantic divergence, and it is declared here rather than reported as a discovery. No query was added or removed after any timing existed.
agreement_rule: hit sets are compared only where every arm's full emission is affordable (yield bounded); the high-yield queries are timed but not set-compared, and that exclusion is stated in the table.

literals.why: absent from every corpus - the zero-hit floor
long literal, medium frequency, many distinct trigrams

regexes.why: .* between two indexable literals - prefilter should still bite
defeats the trigram prefilter (char classes + .*) AND yields ~0 - isolates FIND cost from DELIVER cost
case-insensitivity spelled portably - std::regex ECMAScript has no inline (?i), Rust regex does
bounded repetition over char classes - no literal at all
